abstract: The East Japan Testicular Tumor Study group has studied advanced testicular tumors. Treatment and prognosis of the patients who did not achieved complete response on the primary chemotherapy were discussed in this paper. Also 8 patients who had once reached complete response by primary treatments and relapsed later have been clinically analyzed. 1. Concerning the patients non-achieving complete response on the primary chemotherapy: Two cases who had resection of the residual tumors and 4 cases who had radiation therapy had reached NED in 7 cases of seminoma stage II. Nine of 10 cases in non-seminoma stage II reached NED on resection of the residuals. Moreover, 10 out of 17 cases in stage III showed NED on excision of the residuals. On the other hand, recuperating was very difficult in the cases who could not have excision of residual tumor. The histological findings of the residual tumors after chemotherapy were necrosis and fibrosis in 13 cases, viable cells in 4 cases, teratoma in 6 cases and other 2 cases were not clear. Five out of 15 who had teratoma in the primary lesion had teratoma in the resected residuals on metastatic lesion. On the other hand 5 patients who did not have teratoma originally had no any teratoma elements in the residuals. 2. Concerning the relapse cases by primary treatments: Although relapses were possible in any stages, they were more common with stage IIIB and IIIC cases. Those who achieved complete response after chemotherapy alone fewer relapse than those who had partial response after chemotherapy and there after had excision of residual tumor.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 東日本精巣腫瘍研究グループは進行精巣腫瘍について検討を行った。本論文では、初回化学療法で完全奏効に至らなかった患者の治療と予後、ならびに初回治療で完全奏効に至った後に再発した8例の臨床解析について論じる。1. 初回化学療法で完全奏効に至らなかった患者について：残存腫瘍を切除した2例と放射線療法を受けた4例は、病期II・セミノーマの7例中で無病生存（NED）に至った。病期II・非セミノーマの10例中9例は残存腫瘍の切除により無病生存に至った。さらに病期IIIの17例中10例は残存腫瘍の切除により無病生存を示した。一方、残存腫瘍を切除できなかった症例では回復がきわめて困難であった。化学療法後の残存腫瘍の組織所見は、13例で壊死と線維化、4例で生存腫瘍細胞、6例で奇形腫、残る2例は不明確であった。初発病変に奇形腫を有していた15例中5例は、転移病変の切除検体でも奇形腫成分を認めた。一方、初発時に奇形腫を有していなかった5例では、残存腫瘍に奇形腫成分は認められなかった。2. 初回治療による再発例について：再発はどの病期でも起こりうるが、病期IIIBおよび病期IIICの症例で多く認めた。化学療法のみで完全奏効を得た症例は、化学療法後に部分奏効にとどまり、その後残存腫瘍の切除を受けた症例よりも再発が少なかった。（抄録は250語で打ち切られている）
